credit_share_value.formula: Not paid yet sales / net sales (37 of 51 sales)

credit_share_count.formula: Not paid yet sales / completed sales

credit_share_batch1.formula: credit value / net sales of batch 1

credit_share_batch2.formula: credit value / net sales of batch 2

credit_buyers.formula: buyers with 1+ Not paid yet sale

one_time_buyer_credit_rate.formula: one-time buyers who bought on credit

repeat_buyer_credit_rate.formula: repeat buyers who bought on credit at least once

credit_value_from_repeat_buyers.formula: credit sales value from repeat buyers

days_to_collect_median.formula: sale day -> last payment day, paid in full

credit_sales_paid_in_parts.formula: credit sales with 2+ payments, or a part payment and a balance left

km_days_p50.formula: Kaplan-Meier quantile, open balances right-censored at their age

km_days_p80.formula: Kaplan-Meier quantile, open balances right-censored at their age

km_days_p90.formula: Kaplan-Meier quantile, open balances right-censored at their age

km_days_p95.formula: Kaplan-Meier quantile, open balances right-censored at their age

km_unpaid_after_14.formula: Kaplan-Meier share still unpaid 14 days after the sale

payments_on_a_purchase_day.formula: later payments made on a day the same buyer bought again (not the sale's own day)

still_owed_hhi.formula: Herfindahl index of what is owed, by buyer (1/HHI = equivalent buyers)

receivables_avg_daily.formula: mean of end-of-day receivables, 27 Oct - 26 Nov

dso_steady_state.formula: credit share x value-weighted days to collect

credit_share_last_30_days.formula: Not paid yet sales / net sales, 28 Oct - 26 Nov

owed_days_of_sales_today.formula: still owed / average daily net sales of the last 30 days

rule_fixed_late_after.formula: fixed (SOP 9 / Finance): Late = owed longer than this

rule_fixed_very_late_after.formula: fixed (SOP 9 / Finance): Very late = owed longer than this

rule_fixed_paid_sales_marked_late.formula: fixed (SOP 9 / Finance): share of the 31 paid-in-full sales that were still owed past Late's start

rule_fixed_paid_sales_marked_late_n.formula: fixed (SOP 9 / Finance): number of the 31 paid-in-full sales that would have shown Late before being paid

rule_design_v2_late_after.formula: design v2: Late = owed longer than this

rule_design_v2_very_late_after.formula: design v2: Very late = owed longer than this

rule_design_v2_paid_sales_marked_late.formula: design v2: share of the 31 paid-in-full sales that were still owed past Late's start

rule_design_v2_paid_sales_marked_late_n.formula: design v2: number of the 31 paid-in-full sales that would have shown Late before being paid

rule_paid_only_late_after.formula: paid only (recommended): Late = owed longer than this

rule_paid_only_very_late_after.formula: paid only (recommended): Very late = owed longer than this

rule_paid_only_paid_sales_marked_late.formula: paid only (recommended): share of the 31 paid-in-full sales that were still owed past Late's start

rule_paid_only_paid_sales_marked_late_n.formula: paid only (recommended): number of the 31 paid-in-full sales that would have shown Late before being paid

rule_kaplan_meier_late_after.formula: Kaplan-Meier: Late = owed longer than this

rule_kaplan_meier_very_late_after.formula: Kaplan-Meier: Very late = owed longer than this

rule_kaplan_meier_paid_sales_marked_late.formula: Kaplan-Meier: share of the 31 paid-in-full sales that were still owed past Late's start
Kaplan-Meier: number of the 31 paid-in-full sales that would have shown Late before being paid

selfmask_design_v2_first_very_late_age.formula: age at which a never-paid 16-day balance is first marked Very late (none = never within 45 days)

selfmask_paid_only_first_very_late_age.formula: age at which a never-paid 16-day balance is first marked Very late (none = never within 45 days)

selfmask_kaplan_meier_first_very_late_ag.formula: age at which a never-paid 16-day balance is first marked Very late (none = never within 45 days)

v2_stuck_balances_to_hide_late.formula: open balances aged 30 days needed before design v2's Late start reaches 30 (none flagged)

late_start_90pct_range_n31.formula: 5th-95th pct of p80 over 31 paid sales

late_start_90pct_range_n60.formula: 5th-95th pct of p80 over 60 paid sales

late_start_90pct_range_n120.formula: 5th-95th pct of p80 over 120 paid sales

late_start_90pct_range_n240.formula: 5th-95th pct of p80 over 240 paid sales

backtest_stacked_sales.formula: credit sales to a buyer who already owed at that moment

backtest_over_limit_sales.formula: credit sales where owed + this sale > the buyer's largest fully repaid sale (new buyer: usual credit sale)

backtest_over_limit_pcs_sales.formula: credit sales where owed pieces + this sale > most pieces the buyer repaid on one sale (new buyer: 1)

backtest_late_open_sales.formula: credit sales to a buyer with a Late balance then

buyers_with_3plus_settled.formula: buyers with 3+ credit sales paid in full

settled_sales_from_those_buyers.formula: paid-in-full credit sales by buyers with 3+ of them

own_median_min.formula: lowest own median among those buyers

own_median_max.formula: highest own median among those buyers

backtest_any_warning_sales.formula: credit sales that would have shown a warning

backtest_open_now_with_warning.formula: of today's 6 open sales, how many would have shown a warning when made

backtest_first_time_sales.formula: credit sales that were the buyer's first purchase on credit

days_to_collect_median_first_time.formula: buyer's first credit sale, paid in full

days_to_collect_median_repeat.formula: buyer's later credit sales, paid in full

one_tab_rule_peso_days.formula: old balances x days they stayed open after the buyer took more credit

one_tab_rule_avg_cash_freed.formula: same / 31 days = average cash that would have been in hand

peak_buyer_exposure_max.formula: largest amount one buyer owed at any moment

peak_buyer_exposure_median.formula: median of each credit buyer's peak balance

buyers_peak_over_one_piece.formula: credit buyers who at some point owed more than one pod

pd_usual.formula: (defaults + 0.5) / (paid sales that were still owed at the Usual start + 1)

pd_late.formula: (defaults + 0.5) / (paid sales that were still owed at the Late start + 1)

pd_very_late.formula: (defaults + 0.5) / (paid sales that were still owed at the Very late start + 1)

pd_base.formula: Jeffreys mean, 0 defaults in 31 resolved credit sales

pd_rule_of_three.formula: 3 / n upper bound with 0 events (Hanley & Lippman-Hand 1983)

expected_loss_now.formula: sum of open balance x PD(bucket) x LGD 100%

prob_any_loss_current_book.formula: chance at least one open balance is never paid

stress_largest_buyer.formula: loss if largest buyer (P680) is never paid

stress_both_late_balances.formula: loss if both Late balances is never paid

stress_everything_owed.formula: loss if everything owed is never paid

el_month_now.formula: PD 1.56% x credit sales a month (now)

el_month_full_shelf.formula: PD 1.56% x credit sales a month (full shelf)

cost_per_credit_sale_fin_el.formula: P330 x 3%/month x value-weighted days/30 + base PD x P330

timing_s0_cash_5dec.formula: S0 as now (73% credit, own timing): cash on the order-by day

timing_s0_top_up.formula: S0 as now (73% credit, own timing): owner money needed on the order-by day to order in full

timing_s0_delay_days.formula: S0 as now (73% credit, own timing): days the full order waits for cash

timing_s0_gp_lost.formula: S0 as now (73% credit, own timing): empty days x P354

timing_s1_cash_5dec.formula: S1 every new sale paid at the till: cash on the order-by day

timing_s1_top_up.formula: S1 every new sale paid at the till: owner money needed on the order-by day to order in full

timing_s1_delay_days.formula: S1 every new sale paid at the till: days the full order waits for cash

timing_s1_gp_lost.formula: S1 every new sale paid at the till: empty days x P354

timing_s2_cash_5dec.formula: S2 half of sales on credit: cash on the order-by day

timing_s2_top_up.formula: S2 half of sales on credit: owner money needed on the order-by day to order in full

timing_s2_delay_days.formula: S2 half of sales on credit: days the full order waits for cash

timing_s2_gp_lost.formula: S2 half of sales on credit: empty days x P354

timing_s3_cash_5dec.formula: S3 credit, all paid within 7 days: cash on the order-by day

timing_s3_top_up.formula: S3 credit, all paid within 7 days: owner money needed on the order-by day to order in full

timing_s3_delay_days.formula: S3 credit, all paid within 7 days: days the full order waits for cash

timing_s3_gp_lost.formula: S3 credit, all paid within 7 days: empty days x P354

timing_s4_cash_5dec.formula: S4 credit, all paid by Late's start: cash on the order-by day

timing_s4_top_up.formula: S4 credit, all paid by Late's start: owner money needed on the order-by day to order in full

timing_s4_delay_days.formula: S4 credit, all paid by Late's start: days the full order waits for cash

timing_s4_gp_lost.formula: S4 credit, all paid by Late's start: empty days x P354

timing_s5_cash_5dec.formula: S5 as now, but today's P2,080 collected by 28 Nov: cash on the order-by day

timing_s5_top_up.formula: S5 as now, but today's P2,080 collected by 28 Nov: owner money needed on the order-by day to order in full

timing_s5_delay_days.formula: S5 as now, but today's P2,080 collected by 28 Nov: days the full order waits for cash

timing_s5_gp_lost.formula: S5 as now, but today's P2,080 collected by 28 Nov: empty days x P354

credit_cash_held_back_5dec.formula: cash on 5 Dec with every new sale paid at the till minus as now

timing_s0p_gp_lost.formula: S0p as now, supplier paid on pick-up: empty days x P354

timing_s0p_top_up.formula: S0p as now, supplier paid on pick-up: owner money needed on the pick-up day

timing_s1p_gp_lost.formula: S1p no new credit, supplier paid on pick-up: empty days x P354

timing_s1p_top_up.formula: S1p no new credit, supplier paid on pick-up: owner money needed on the pick-up day

credit_timing_cost_next_order.formula: GP lost S0 - S1 on Batch 4 (waiting for the full order)

tied_up_1.94.formula: steady-state DSO 6.84 x 1.94 pieces x P330

tied_up_2.22.formula: steady-state DSO 6.84 x 2.22 pieces x P330

tied_up_3.61.formula: steady-state DSO 6.84 x 3.61 pieces x P330

cash_freed_cap7.formula: (steady DSO - DSO with every collection by day 7) x net sales a day

cash_freed_cap11.formula: (steady DSO - DSO with every collection by day 11) x net sales a day

cash_freed_per_10pts_credit.formula: 10 points of credit share moved to the till x value-weighted days x net sales a day

credit_decision_p_star_if_no_sale.formula: chance of being paid above which a one-off credit sale beats no sale: landed cost P171.60 / price P340

breakeven_pd_inc0.formula: (share of credit sales that need credit 0% x P159.45 margin - P3.1 financing) / P330

breakeven_pd_inc5.formula: (share of credit sales that need credit 5% x P159.45 margin - P3.1 financing) / P330

breakeven_pd_inc10.formula: (share of credit sales that need credit 10% x P159.45 margin - P3.1 financing) / P330

breakeven_pd_inc25.formula: (share of credit sales that need credit 25% x P159.45 margin - P3.1 financing) / P330

breakeven_pd_inc50.formula: (share of credit sales that need credit 50% x P159.45 margin - P3.1 financing) / P330
